name: HTML/CSS composition render
guidance: An HTML/CSS/code composition (markup + motion timeline) rendered to frames, then to MP4, by a local open-source frames renderer. Best for motion graphics, kinetic typography, data/number reveals, and composited real-UI beats with precise word-anchored timing. Vector (SVG) assets are the fidelity unlock — raster screenshots dropped in look pasted-on. Can carry a local text-to-speech voice inline.
